indications.trial_status: PLANNED — IND pathway in dialogue with FDA following 2026 rebrand pivot from Alzheimer's
key_milestones: Progress update on TSC-related epilepsy program expected 2026

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Lead asset simufilam Phase 3 in Alzheimer's disease (NCT05026177, NCT05575076 OLE) was terminated in November 2024 after failing to show clinical benefit. Company rebranded from Cassava Sciences to Filana Therapeutics in March 2026 and pivoted to TSC-related epilepsy with simufilam, but no Phase 1/2/3 trial has been initiated yet for the new indication.
